# Vendored headless-bwsim runtime

This directory contains the v0.1.4 wrapper baseline plus a newer downloaded
engine binary and a reproducible BW Forge export patch. The revision of the
new engine binary is not established here; its exact hash is recorded below.
The upstream repository remains the source of truth for the wrapper baseline.

- Wrapper baseline: `v0.1.4`
- Wrapper baseline commit: `d8a1015464afbab9fc1d3d7426fc7e8952ce5e85`
- License declared upstream: MIT
- Original Wasm SHA-256: `fa32729abbef46853f89c2ed60b4b22130c6e9cb40471ba446c3f8193404b760`
- Patched Wasm SHA-256: `3f41196ff3f15cbadcb5afedca5ebdeae8905c018bc1a696f3d008963280bf5e`
- `sim.pack.gz` SHA-256: `32f8cc3561e11d2756a579dc54675e0758e94c15b9f767a66a1ba533a9856a44`

BW Forge uses `bwsim_wasm.bwforge.wasm`, generated by
`scripts/patch-connected-runtime.mjs`. The source module already exports
`bw_unit_connected_unit_id(index) -> i32`; the patch clones that complete
function and replaces its parent-pointer load with NOPs to add the matching
generation-bearing `bw_unit_instance_id(index) -> i32` export. The v0.1.4
wrapper also exposes the engine's five-slot production queue and applies the
generation-aware SCR replay-local UnitId conversion, including extended unload
opcode `0x62`, during REP-to-DRPL conversion through the upstream JavaScript
API. It retains the classified replay UnitId namespace and provides checked
native-to-replay ID conversion for compatibility serialization. The unpatched
Wasm is retained as the patch input and for provenance.

The checked-in `dist` JavaScript and declarations include the local connected
unit wrapper adaptation; their source maps retain the upstream mapping metadata.

To refresh this directory, record the new engine revision when known, update
the hash-pinned patch for that exact binary, regenerate the patched artifact,
and verify the wrapper, replay fixtures, and hashes before updating provenance.
